entry.title: BILL016(26) (Honolulu): PUBLISH → ILA
entry.content:
RELATING TO THE REGULATION OF DOGS.

Provides that it is unlawful for an owner of a dog to allow the dog to become, or fail to reasonably prevent the dog from becoming, a stray. Requires the CSD Director or the head of the City agency designated by the Mayor to require the animal control contractor to enforce the provisions contained in ROH Chapter 12, Article 4. TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE WEST HAWAI‘I VETERANS CEMETERY DEVELOPMENT AND EXPANSION ASSOCIATION TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE MEDAL OF HONOR MEMORIAL

Transfers $10,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
